sources.excerpt: Official Courtside Thai Cuisine site lists 3981 Chain Bridge Road, Fairfax, VA 22030, phone (703) 223-5400, and current hours: Tuesday-Saturday 11 a.m.-9 p.m., Sunday noon-9 p.m., Monday closed.

Current official four-tab menu was inspected completely: Starters, Entrees, Grill/Seafood/Curries, and Noodles/Rice/Sides. It exposes 99 consolidated food products and direct ingredient descriptions but no allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

The official Carryout link resolves to the exact-address Courtside Thai Cuisine Clover storefront. Its 115 customer-facing labels were inspected and consolidated across protein and lunch/dinner variants; it adds six current ordering products beyond the official web menu.
Fresh official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, ingredients, nutrition, PDF, and cross-contact resources found no restaurant-issued allergen document.
Exact-brand and Fairfax-targeted searches surfaced the official menu and current location references but no authoritative item-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: Official and official-linked exact-address surfaces confirm a single current Courtside Thai Cuisine operation at 3981 Chain Bridge Road in Fairfax.
The complete current food and nonalcoholic boundary contains 105 canonical products: 99 on the official menu plus six current Clover-only products, adding 44 products beyond the frozen 61-row slice.
Clover repeats protein variants and lunch/dinner presentations; these were consolidated under stable products instead of creating duplicate menu items.

No comprehensive item-by-allergen matrix or restaurant-level cross-contact statement was found after all four required searches. Only direct supported positive claims were retained; empty unavailable arrays are not absence claims.
